The present graph-subdivision random-initial-data coefficient formula, cycle-rank exponent, and co-tree amplitude need independent quantitative proof and were not identified in inspected literature or published-finding corpus searches. Prior published/archived claims have been compared by implication, with the inaccessible 1995 source noted as an explicit residual risk.

value.rationale: Exact synchronizing mass and its polynomial decay on stretched networks are intrinsic stochastic-dynamical statistics; the half-cycle-rank exponent gives a universal law and the co-tree determinant quantifies topological and length-weight effects. This is a motivated full-family classification, not a numerical isolated example or elementary restatement of the 2016 qualitative criterion.
